changes.title: Maine Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Platner on Senate ballot
changes.summary: Maine Democrats gathered Saturday to select former state Senate President Troy Jackson as the Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner on the ballot.

changes.title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate

changes.title: Democrats in Maine gather to replace Graham Platner in the race against Susan Collins
